Text:
Small thing, big difference: every page is single-sided.

Because a 4-year-old with a texta does not do "lightly". Blank backs mean markers never bleed through to the next picture — in the paperback and in the printable.

Printing tips for the PDF:
• Plain copy paper for pencils and crayons
• 120gsm+ or light card for textas
• Printer set to "Fit to page"
• Print as many copies as you like — siblings, classrooms, the cousins at Christmas lunch

Text:
Why "Little Dinkums"?

Dinkum: genuine, the real thing. Little Dinkums are the small people who colour outside the lines with total commitment.

We wanted a kids' range that looked like our Christmas — hot, loud, half at the beach — drawn big and simple enough for a two-year-old's fist. And a grown-up range (Long Weekend) for when the house finally goes quiet.

Made in Melbourne. More books on the way — Aussie Animals, The Beach, Farm Friends.
